note: Order of the guided run (/grammar/path) and of every topic list sorted by level (src/lib/lehrplan.js). This is a teaching decision, not a derived sort: within a level, what later topics build on comes first. French order (2026-11-08, grammar-structure run): A1 starts with the subject pronouns and être/avoir (every early sentence needs them), then gender, articles, plurals and adjective agreement, numbers, the -er present with ne … pas and the two kinds of question, il y a / c'est, the key irregulars and the -ir/-re groups, and the small everyday structures; A2 starts with reflexives, frequency and quantity (partitive, article or not), the two verb phrases that need no new forms (futur proche, en train de / venir de), then the passé composé with avoir and with être and the imparfait, negation beyond pas, object pronouns and the imperative that places them, the modal verbs and polite requests, comparison, indefinites, adverbs and place; B1 opens with passé composé or imparfait and depuis / il y a, then the pronouns y / en and their order, the relatives, then the futur simple with time and si clauses, the conditionnel and the subjunctive (forms, wishes, infinitive or subjunctive, pour que), and ends with linkers, pronouns and verb patterns; B2 starts with the plus-que-parfait, because si clauses and reported speech use it, then the subjunctive after opinion and concession, lequel, participle agreement, the passive and the gérondif, and ends with spoken markers; C1 starts with the futur antérieur and the subjonctif passé and ends with formal writing and the passé simple for reading. Only topics listed here are part of the run (core). Topics left out are extra practice (reference and word-formation topics: wortarten, wortbildung-nomen): they keep their page and their place in the index, but they do not lengthen the run. Each topic must be listed under its own `level`. Drafts ("status": "entwurf") only count once they are reviewed. An entry "id:A2" would be the A2 part of a topic that teaches two levels on one page (exercise titles "A2: …"); no French topic does this at the moment. `akkusativ` has its own page (/object-pronouns) and is named for the sorted lists, not as a run station. Keep GRAMMATIK_ORDER in src/lib/grammatikOrder.js in step.
